claims.text: She refused anterior chamber paracentesis and was not willing to undergo thrombolysis, so she was managed with topical intraocular pressure-lowering drops such as Brinzolamide and Timolol, ocular massage and Aspirin 75 mg without significant improvement. Emergency hyperbaric oxygen therapy almost seven hours after symptom onset improved vision from perception of light to hand movements. A thrombotic non-arteritic cause was thought probable and polycythemia vera was considered but not confirmed.
